plain_english_summary: Deterministic spike-event encoding and replay system for bounded extracellular recording lanes, with blind-clone replay now closed and the first DANDI 000003 breadth attempt truthfully recorded as a fail.
commercial_wedge: For neurotech research-infrastructure teams needing deterministic, reproducible spike-event encoding of extracellular neural recordings with auditable proof lineage. Business value: reproducibility and auditability for spike-event pipelines. Note: this is a lossy spike extractor, not a lossless signal compressor, and commercialization-safe closure remains open.
technical_wedge: Deterministic spike-event encoding applied to extracellular neural signals, evidenced by April 24 blind-clone replay closure, a preserved DANDI 000034 authority anchor, a counted IBL second-target PASS, and a truthful DANDI 000003 fail receipt. Codec is a lossy spike extractor; headline compression ratios are window-scoped.
ideal_first_buyer: Neurotech research-infrastructure team or academic neuroscience platform needing deterministic spike-event encoding with proof lineage.
deployment_model: Python package on PyPI (`zpe-neuro`), private-staged proof surface.
not_claimed: No broad neural generality — extracellular lane only
family_position: Validates ZPE encoding generality to neural signal domains. Staged/validation tier alongside Mocap, Prosody, and Bio.
